name: Tokyo
note: Precipitation imported from the complete-quality daily export: at least 99.89% of baseline days in every calendar month. Temperature stays grid: the agency marks a homogeneity break at the 2014-12-02 Otemachi–Kitanomaru move, provides no daily adjustment, and neither segment alone meets the unchanged 1991–2020 policy.

name: Kyoto
note: Temperature and precipitation imported from the official 1991–2020 daily export using only complete quality code 8. Every month exceeds 99.67% coverage. Station 47759 is 3.51 km from the reference point, with a 4.2 m elevation difference; the record retains one agency homogeneity segment.

name: Seoul
note: Temperature imported from 60 public annual daily tables for Songwol-dong station 108; every calendar month exceeds 99.89% coverage. These reference tables provide no per-record quality codes. Numeric ASOS observations have an attribution licence. Precipitation stays grid because blank rain cells cannot safely be treated as dry days.
